item.title: Cleveland State men blown out by Youngstown State, 106-82, for fourth straight loss
item.description: The Cleveland State men’s basketball team lost its fourth game in a row, 106-82, to host Youngstown State on Feb. 18. The Vikings (10-18, 6-11), who were playing without leading scorer Dayan Nessah, fell into 10th place in the 11-team Horizon League. Youngstown State never trailed and opened a double-digit lead midway through the first half. The Penguins shot 63.5 percent from the field, including 14 of 22 3-pointers. item.title: Grand Rapids hands Monsters a 3-2 defeat
item.description: Longtime rival Grand Rapids handed the Monsters a 3-2 loss on Feb. 18. Owen Sillinger scored a power-play goal for the Monsters, his 12th of the season. Brendan Gaunce also found the back of the net for his ninth of the year. Ivan Fedotov made 22 saves in the Cleveland net. The Monsters (25-16-6-1) return to Rocket Arena on Feb. 20 for the first of two games against the Marlies.
